title: Canonical completion units and finite open–closed locality on qcqs schemes
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], work on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $B_T=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_T$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and use $D(B_T)$, the unbounded derived category of $B_T$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

For $H\in D(B_T)$ put $C_T(H)=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n(H\otimes^L_{B_T}(A_n)_T)$, with strict quotient transitions, restriction of scalars along $B_T\to(A_n)_T$, and the functorial product mapping-fiber model [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Write $\eta_H:H\to C_T(H)$ for the canonical quotient augmentation (zero shifted-product coordinate) [def-pur-integral-derived-operations].

The map $\eta_H$ is an isomorphism if and only if $H$ is derived complete in the Roos-triangle sense of [def-weil-derived-complete]. This asserts invertibility of this specified augmentation, rather than of an arbitrary triangulated lift of the quotient maps.

Let $r:S\to T$ be either a weakly etale object of $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with $S$ qcqs, or a closed immersion whose open complement is quasi-compact [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Ordinary inverse image of module sheaves is exact, the finite-projection map $r^{-1}B_T\to B_S$ is an isomorphism, and there is a natural isomorphism $r^*C_T(H)\cong C_S(r^*H)$ carrying $r^*\eta_H$ to $\eta_{r^*H}$. It identifies every finite reduction and quotient transition with the corresponding reduction and transition on $S$, and ordinary restriction preserves derived completeness.

Suppose a finite rooted binary tree of qcqs locally closed subschemes has root $T$ and each internal vertex is split into a quasi-compact open subscheme and its closed complement. Choose on every nonempty leaf a pro-etale covering family with qcqs domains. Then $\eta_H$ is an isomorphism if and only if its restrictions to all those covering domains are isomorphisms. Equivalently $H$ is derived complete if and only if all its leaf-cover restrictions are derived complete. Empty leaves impose no condition.

All 12 non-Mathlib proof deps are declared in tool_uses and I accept them: the unit sk-rem-sf-pf-done has no steps, and each one is a generic sheaf or derived-category tool. The other 4 are Mathlib leaves. Sources read in Stacks proetale.tex: 099M lemma-naive-completion, 09BL lemma-closed-immersion-affines-apply, 09BM lemma-closed-immersion-complement-retrocompact-exact, 09AH lemma-ses-associated-to-open. The quasi-compact-open hypothesis is exactly what 09AH and 09BM need. Steps: (1) lem-sf-open-quotient-koszul-completeness gives comp=u, c∘κ=u and Roos-completeness ⇔ κ invertible; prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction gives c invertible; so η is invertible ⇔ H is complete. (2) Closed case: limit-preserving, exact module inverse image with no Noetherian hypothesis. Weakly étale case: slice localization with A_X|_W≅A_W. The constant-ring map preserves constant sections and is compatible with transitions, which gives r^{-1}B_T≅B_S with the right projections. (3) The reduction-pullback tower lemma applies (ring iso, F exact and left adjoint), with τ compatible with transitions and τF(i)=i. (4) Products are exact on both sides; the strict-limit comparison plus its augmentation clause carries Fη to η_{FH}, so completeness is preserved. (5) The open/closed node supplies every hypothesis of the unbounded open/closed calculus, which gives joint reflection of isomorphisms. One small advisory point: that node states isomorphisms j^{-1}j_!≅id and i^{-1}i_*≅id rather than invertible unit and counit, but any natural iso id≅RL forces the unit to be invertible. (6) Cohomology sheaves plus the cover-local isomorphism leaf; I checked the covering condition V×_L W_a→V. (7) Elementary induction including empty leaves (the empty family covers ∅). Edge cases checked: T=∅, H=0, height-0 tree, empty children, identity closed immersion. Duplicates: lem-sf-immersion-completed-pullback-comparison covers only the closed-immersion part of clause (b). The NF and Q61 stratum nodes assume a Noetherian X. The Q153 nodes lem-sfb-strict-completion-restriction-comparison and lem-sfb-finite-strata-completion-detection (unsplit, same day) state the analogue for internal condensed B_T=p_T^*A, a different coefficient category. None of these is a duplicate of the item. Maintainer note: consider a bridge or merge between this item and those condensed-coefficient analogues later. No fixes.

theorem qcqsCompletionUnitLocality
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (T : Scheme.{t}) [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (_hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) :
    (∀ H : D l E T none,
      IsIso ((completionUnit l E T none).app H) ↔ IsComplete l E T none H) ∧
    (∀ (S : Scheme.{t}) [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] (r : S ⟶ T),
      (WeaklyEtale r ∨ (IsClosedImmersion r ∧ IsCompact ((Set.range r.base)ᶜ))) →
      PreservesFiniteLimits (ordinaryPull l E r) ∧
      PreservesFiniteColimits (ordinaryPull l E r) ∧
      IsIso (ordinaryCoefficientMap l E r) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ordinaryCoefficientMap l E r ≫
          limit.π (integralCoefficientSheafSystem l E S) (op n) =
        (ordinaryRingInverse.{t, u} r).map
            (limit.π (integralCoefficientSheafSystem l E T) (op n)) ≫
          ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (ordinaryRingPush.{t, u} r)).homEquiv _ _).symm
              (ordinaryFiniteRingMap l E r n)) ∧
      (∃ (τ : tower l E T none ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ (Cx l E T none) (Cx l E S none)).obj
            (ordinaryComplexPull l E r) ≅
          ordinaryComplexPull l E r ⋙ tower l E S none)
        (χ : roos l E T none ⋙ ordinaryComplexPull l E r ≅
          ordinaryComplexPull l E r ⋙ roos l E S none)
        (hgood : ∀ P : (Good l E T none).FullSubcategory,
          Good l E S none ((ordinaryComplexPull l E r).obj P.obj))
        (α : completion l E T none ⋙ ordinaryDerivedPull l E r ≅
          ordinaryDerivedPull l E r ⋙ completion l E S none),
        (∀ (P : Cx l E T none) (n : ℕ),
          (ordinaryComplexPull l E r).map (((augmentation l E T none).app P).app (op n)) ≫
              (τ.hom.app P).app (op n) =
            ((augmentation l E S none).app ((ordinaryComplexPull l E r).obj P)).app (op n)) ∧
        (∀ P : Cx l E T none,
          χ.hom.app P ≫ CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
              (ordinaryRoosEndomorphism l E ((ordinaryComplexPull l E r).obj P)) =
            (ordinaryComplexPull l E r).map
                (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst (ordinaryRoosEndomorphism l E P)) ≫
              piComparison (ordinaryComplexPull l E r)
                (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((tower l E T none).obj P).obj (op n)) ≫
              Limits.Pi.map (fun n : ℕ ↦ (τ.hom.app P).app (op n))) ∧
        (∀ (P : Cx l E T none) (i : ℤ),
          (χ.hom.app P).f i ≫
              (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
                (ordinaryRoosEndomorphism l E ((ordinaryComplexPull l E r).obj P))).v
                  i (i + -1) rfl =
            (ordinaryPull l E r).map
                ((CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd (ordinaryRoosEndomorphism l E P)).v
                  i (i + -1) rfl) ≫
              (piComparison (ordinaryComplexPull l E r)
                (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((tower l E T none).obj P).obj (op n))).f (i + -1) ≫
              (Limits.Pi.map (fun n : ℕ ↦ (τ.hom.app P).app (op n))).f (i + -1)) ∧
        (∀ P : (Good l E T none).FullSubcategory,
          (ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).map ((completionComparison l E T none).hom.app P) ≫
              ordinaryComplexCounit l E r ((roos l E T none).obj P.obj) ≫
              DerivedCategory.Q.map (χ.hom.app P.obj) =
            α.hom.app ((qGood l E T none).obj P) ≫
              (completion l E S none).map (ordinaryComplexCounit l E r P.obj) ≫
              (completionComparison l E S none).hom.app
                ⟨(ordinaryComplexPull l E r).obj P.obj, hgood P⟩) ∧
        (∀ H : D l E T none,
          (ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).map ((completionUnit l E T none).app H) ≫
              α.hom.app H =
            (completionUnit l E S none).app ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).obj H))) ∧
      (∀ H : D l E T none, IsComplete l E T none H →
        IsComplete l E S none ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).obj H))) ∧
    (∀ (d : ℕ) (V : Fin d → Scheme.{t}) (toT : ∀ v : Fin d, V v ⟶ T)
      (root : Fin d) (parent left right : Fin d → Fin d)
      (leftEdge : ∀ v : Fin d, V (left v) ⟶ V v)
      (rightEdge : ∀ v : Fin d, V (right v) ⟶ V v) (leaf : Fin d → Prop),
      (∃ e : V root ≅ T, e.hom = toT root) → parent root = root →
      (∀ v, v ≠ root → (parent v).val < v.val) →
      (∀ v, CompactSpace (V v)) → (∀ v, QuasiSeparatedSpace (V v)) →
      (∀ v, IsImmersion (toT v)) →
      (∀ v, v ≠ root → left (parent v) = v ∨ right (parent v) = v) →
      (∀ v, leaf v ↔ ∀ z, z ≠ root → parent z ≠ v) →
      (∀ v, ¬ leaf v →
        left v ≠ right v ∧ v.val < (left v).val ∧ v.val < (right v).val ∧
        parent (left v) = v ∧ parent (right v) = v ∧
        leftEdge v ≫ toT v = toT (left v) ∧ rightEdge v ≫ toT v = toT (right v) ∧
        IsOpenImmersion (leftEdge v) ∧ QuasiCompact (leftEdge v) ∧
        IsClosedImmersion (rightEdge v) ∧
        Set.range (leftEdge v).base ∪ Set.range (rightEdge v).base = Set.univ ∧
        Disjoint (Set.range (leftEdge v).base) (Set.range (rightEdge v).base)) →
      ∀ (I : ∀ v : Fin d, Type w) (W : ∀ v : Fin d, I v → (V v).ProEt),
      (∀ (v : Fin d) (a : I v), leaf v → Nonempty (V v) → CompactSpace (W v a).left) →
      (∀ (v : Fin d) (a : I v), leaf v → Nonempty (V v) →
        QuasiSeparatedSpace (W v a).left) →
      (∀ v, leaf v → Nonempty (V v) →
        Presieve.ofArrows (fun a : I v ↦ W v a)
          (fun a ↦ (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (W v a).hom (Category.comp_id _) :
            W v a ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 (V v)))) ∈
          ProEt.precoverage (V v) (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (V v)))) →
      ∀ H : D l E T none,
        (IsIso ((completionUnit l E T none).app H) ↔
          ∀ v, leaf v → Nonempty (V v) → ∀ a : I v,
            IsIso ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E ((W v a).hom ≫ toT v)).map
              ((completionUnit l E T none).app H))) ∧
        (IsComplete l E T none H ↔
          ∀ v, leaf v → Nonempty (V v) → ∀ a : I v,
            IsComplete l E (W v a).left none
              ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E ((W v a).hom ≫ toT v)).obj H)))
